messages:
elaine_cs: FYI — handing off 'batchsize thermostat' plan for AcmeCorp dedicated pool. Need autoscale policy, quota window + load test slot. Target go-live: Thu 09:00 PDT. Who can own infra changes?

mike_ops: I can take infra changes. Do we have spike profile? what's expected RPS / concurrency?

elaine_cs: Traffic shape: steady 80 req/s with 600ms p95 under baseline; bursts up to 250 req/s for 10m. We'll run warmup + bake tests. Quota ask: +40% headroom for first 72h.

sam_ml: For model, recommend batch_size=8 for cost vs latency. We'll provide a quantized variant if needed. Also provide prompt set to validate quality post-quant.

jordan_eng: Ok. Proposed autoscale policy:
```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 12
scale_metric: avg_concurrency_per_replica
scale_target: 6
cooldown_sec: 90
burst_buffer: 2
```
We'll tie to queue_length SLO and per-route token budget.

elaine_cs: Looks good. Can you schedule a slot for load tests? Prefer Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC (low production traffic).

mike_ops: Wed 02:00 UTC works for infra. I'll reserve nodes and pre-warm cache. Need the exact k6 script.

sam_ml: k6 script (trimmed):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt:'<acme-priming>'}), {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer x'}})
}
```
Run with: `k6 run -u 80 -d 30m script.js` then ramp to 250rps for 10m.

elaine_cs: Also: quota window request — customer needs reserved token quota of 1.2M tokens/day for 3 days. @mike_ops can you open billing ticket?

mike_ops: Filed ticket #CS-8421 with finance and billing. ETA approval 6-8h.

deploy-bot: test-run scheduled by @mike_ops: load-test (acme-batchsize-thermostat) at 2025-11-12T02:00:00Z. Status: queued. :rocket:

jordan_eng: Reminder: add fallback policy to route to smaller model variant if latency >= 1.5s for 60s window. Config snippet:
```
fallback_policy:
  threshold_ms: 1500
  window_sec: 60
  fallback_model: 'redwood-small-v2'
```

sam_ml: Also ensure KV cache priming step: run 10k warmup prompts to populate prefix caches, otherwise first-token latency spikes.

elaine_cs: Post-test checklist: 1) confirm p95 < 800ms for steady; 2) check error rate < 0.5%; 3) validate 10 random prompts vs baseline for quality drift.

mike_ops: I'll paste logs to the thread after the run.

jordan_eng: If autoscale overshoots we can adjust cooldown to 120s. Monitor CPU/GPU util and queue length.

sam_ml: QA will run eval harness after run. Will tag results here.

elaine_cs: Thanks — owners: Infra: @mike_ops, Runtime: @jordan_eng, ML: @sam_ml. I'll coordinate customer comms. :thumbsup:

mike_ops: Roger.

deploy-bot: run started: acme-batchsize-thermostat | run_id=run-20251112-0001

mike_ops: Warmup complete — 10k priming calls done. First pass steady 80rps p95=620ms.

sam_ml: QA harness started.

jordan_eng: Autoscale behaved: ramped to 4 replicas at 250rps, max observed replicas=5 (one extra buffer). GPU util peaked 78%.

mike_ops: Final steady verification: p95=740ms during burst window, errors=0.12%. Quota holding.

sam_ml: Quality checks: no regression on 10/10 sampled prompts. embedding similarity within tolerance.

elaine_cs: Great. Closing handoff — will send customer summary and renewal note.

mike_ops: Closing ticket #CS-8421 as approved.

deploy-bot: run completed: acme-batchsize-thermostat | run_id=run-20251112-0001 | status=success
